column1: # ZAP baseline rule triage for security.yml: rule id, action (IGNORE/WARN/FAIL), reason.
# Anything not listed uses ZAP defaults; with fail_action every WARN fails the job.
# The header findings of the first scan (CSP directives, inline styles, Permissions-Policy,
# COOP/COEP/CORP) were fixed in the SUT, not ignored here.

column3: (Modern Web Application: informational; the UI is a single-page app by design)
(Suspicious Comments: words such as "select" and "user" inside the minified React vendor bundle; reviewed, no secrets or internal notes)

(Non-Storable Content: informational characterisation of caching. The policy is deliberate: content-hashed /assets/* are public and immutable for a year, pages and API responses are no-store; asserted by SecuritySmokeTest)
(ZAP is Out of Date: the ZAP image is pinned on purpose, so the gate changes only through a reviewed version bump; a moving "stable" tag broke the scan on 2026-10-20)
